feed.title: Aevex Corp. (AVEX) Shareholders Who Lost Money Have Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Lawsuit
feed.summary: Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP has announced a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Aevex Corp. (AVEX), inviting shareholders who suffered losses to become lead plaintiffs. The lawsuit alleges that Aevex and certain underwriters made false statements between April 14, 2026, and June 4, 2026, by failing to disclose a pre-arranged plan to abrogate a lock-up and conduct a secondary public offering (SPO) shortly after the IPO, where all proceeds went to Madison, not Aevex. feed.title: McDonald's 30% Slide Has Made It Cheaper, but Traffic Is Still the Problem

McDonald's new strategy, NEXT, aims to improve restaurant economics and efficiency, with visitor traffic being the key metric to watch for a successful rebound.

feed.title: Costco faces federal lawsuit accusing retailer of selling products linked to child and forced labor
feed.summary: Costco is facing a federal class-action lawsuit in Oregon, alleging the retailer sells products sourced from child and forced labor. The lawsuit claims chocolate, cashews, and shrimp sold by Costco are linked to exploitation in West Africa, Brazil, Vietnam, Guinea-Bissau, and India. The suit seeks $200 for each eligible Oregon Costco member and an injunction to halt the company's "unlawful" business practices, highlighting Costco's marketing as an "ethically sourced" retailer.

feed.title: John Deere Financial, AgVend Bring 0% & Low Rate Crop Input Financing into Retail Quote

feed.title: Starbucks loses bid to dismiss labor union's trademark case

This legal dispute is part of ongoing tensions between Starbucks and the union that began five years ago when the first employees unionized.
